name: smart-notch
changelog: Hotfix: Resolved Microsoft Store package issue where keyboard volume/brightness OSD notch popups and Bluetooth device status monitoring were prevented by package archive restrictions.
Premium Bespoke Hardware Badges: Authentic Apple Silicon CPU microchip die, DRAM memory modules, sculpted acoustic headphones, and Wi-Fi radar wave badges.
Adaptive Side Docking Architecture: Refined side notch geometries, vertically expanding Bluetooth alerts, and balanced vertical centering.
Persistent Pin Mode: Keep dynamic notch pinned open without accidental closing on mouse-leave or loss of focus.
Performance Optimization: Memoized view trees, zero-overhead background monitoring, and smooth hardware-accelerated transitions.
author: Avinash
description: Smart Notch – a Dynamic Island experience for Windows.
